headlines.description: — Nick Poulos accounted for three touchdowns, including the go-ahead score with 1:16 remaining, as Ohio rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Ball State 35-28 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Poulos accounts for 3 TDs, including go-ahead score, to help Ohio edge Ball State 35-28

events.name: Miami (OH) RedHawks at Kent State Golden Flashes

headlines.description: — D'Shawntae Jones ran for 121 yards and two touchdowns, and Miami (Ohio) beat Kent State 20-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones' 2TDs help lead Miami (Ohio) to dominant 20-3 win over Kent State
